cost: Initial storage Q=sum (|f|+1)|e|+prior entries before dedup; sort each column. Iterations O(I*(sum |e|(|f|+1) log Rmax+R+P log Rmax)) time and O(Q+R+nf) memory; align O(|e||f|log Rmax).
description: Vocab assigns sorted unique IDs1.., missing0. train_prior builds sorted cooccurrence/prior rows, initializes uniform, repeats fractional counts against NULL then adds prior pseudocounts and normalizes positive rows. align maximizes t*exp(-2*relative-distance) over NULL*.3.

inverse: Unlisted row/column lookup returns0; zero score cannot beat NULL tie. Training does not load a linguistic model or corpus itself.
Rows admit many repeated/reordered training pairs and priors yielding same normalized counts. Alignment output identifies inequality cells in row probabilities, not unique lexical meaning.
limitations: No live corpus/model/teacher/GPU execution or language accuracy claim

state: Source IDs<=nf, nf+1 and vocab ids representable; alpha finite nonnegative, sums finite; no claim for NaN/negative priors. Prior duplicates intentionally counted.
